text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 104,133 to 85,588 despite several trades; I should judge decisions by their long-term rationale, not assume activity will improve results.","I repeatedly added to Stock B after selling some at a loss, increasing exposure without evidence that its prospects had improved; I should set limits and reassess before adding to a declining holding.","With an apartment goal within ten years, I should balance growth with diversification and a suitable level of risk rather than let losses or short-term price moves drive my choices."]}
